Name: JP's Carpenter's Apprentice
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[center][font=Georgia][b][i][size=6][color=#00ff00][u]Carpenter's Apprentice[/u][/color][/size][/i][/b][/font][/center]


[font=Georgia][size=5][b][i][color=#ff00ff]A little extra help is always necessary, and it never hurts. I still remember when I helped my other uncle by holding his ladder. His last words were: “[/color][color=#00ffff]Hold the ladder steady, you upside down sausage![/color][color=#ff00ff]” I was left wondering how a sausage could be upside down, and I let go of the ladder... Oopsie.[/color][/i][/b][/size]

[/font]
[list]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]This mod adds a new mechanic, the carpenter's apprentice, which allows you to build a second building [b][color=#00ffff]at any time[/color][/b]. [/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]When you ask Robin to build something, her assistant will be available to continue with the construction work. [/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]The apprentice only appears when building. In Robin's shop, it will just be a imaginary NPC that allows you to hire him to build when Robin is busy (building or going to train, for example).[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]The apprentice cannot attend the store to purchase resources, nor can you ask him to upgrade your house. [/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Like Robin, he doesn't work at festivals.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][font=Georgia][size=4]Various messages are added when interacting with the store to find out the current status of both builders, whether both are busy, only one is busy, both are free, etc.[/size][/font][/font][/*]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][color=#00ffff][b]You can configure the mod using GMCM to add up to 3 apprentices at the same time. [/b][/color][/size][/font][/*]
[/list]

[font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]That's all there is to it. It's quite concise, but there's a process behind it. Speeding things up a little never hurts. It works with any building, including Mods. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][font=Georgia][color=#00ff00][size=5][b][i]More features are added by installing my other mod, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43034]Merchant's Books[/url]. [/i][/b][/size][/color]


[i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[size=4]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
